name: renderer
title: Renderer
summary: Yea's 3D rendering engine to drop into a view: PBR materials, a coloured sun, point and spot lights, light culling in compute, cascaded and cached local shadows, ambient occlusion, contact shadows, reflection probes, ray-traced and screen-space reflections, variable-rate shading, temporal antialiasing, FSR upscaling, auto exposure and tonemapping, with every part tunable in F1.
